_readme: This file controls the example scripts the dashboard generates for Flightsheets, Overclocking, and Watchdog (the 'New' button / auto-generated raw content). Edit the values/templates below to change what gets generated - no app.js edit or redeploy needed. The dashboard re-fetches this file on every page load.

%Placeholder% tokens inside a *_template string get replaced with live values from the dashboard form fields when the script is generated. Matching is exact and case-sensitive, including the % on both sides - a typo'd placeholder name will not be replaced and will show up literally in the generated script instead.
flightsheet.cpu_template / flightsheet.gpu_template have exactly ONE placeholder: %RIG_GPU_JSON%.

It gets filled with the rig-gpu.json body (pretty-printed JSON, matching the rig-side generate_rig_gpu_json_from_conf()/convert-conf-to-rig-gpu-json.sh output) built by buildRigGpuJsonBody() in app.js from the Flightsheet form fields - custom vs. built-in miner, splitting POOL into url+pool_ssl, etc. need real branching logic, not just a field substitution, so that part isn't editable from this file the way the wrapper text (the tee target path, the systemctl service name) still is.
%Lock Core Clock% %Core Clock Offset% %Lock Memory Clock% %Memory Clock Offset% %Power Limit% - direct field values.
%Fan Args% - filled in automatically by the dashboard as either ' --setfan <value>' (percent fan mode) or '' (empty, curve mode) - not a raw field value, leave this placeholder as-is.
%FAN Curve% - the fan curve string (e.g. '30:30,40:45,50:65'), only used when the Fan field is a curve instead of a percent.

watchdog.conf_dir / watchdog.conf_path are plain values (not templates with placeholders) - the directory watchdog config gets mkdir'd into, and the full path the watchdog conf file gets written to/read from on each worker.

flightsheet.cpu_template:
tee /etc/rigcontrol/rig-cpu.json > /dev/null <<'EOF'
%RIG_GPU_JSON%
EOF
sudo systemctl restart docker_events_cpu
flightsheet.gpu_template:
tee /etc/rigcontrol/rig-gpu.json > /dev/null <<'EOF'
%RIG_GPU_JSON%
EOF
sudo systemctl restart docker_events_gpu

overclocking.apply_script_header:
sudo tee /usr/local/bin/gpu_apply_ocs.sh > /dev/null <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
# gpu_apply_ocs.sh <algo_name> / <custom miner name>
# Generated from the dashboard's Overclock module - edit there, not by hand.
# Note: a row's Algorithm field can list multiple comma-separated algo names
# (e.g. keryxhash,keryx-miner,keryx-minerx) - they're combined into one case
# pattern below, joined by '|', so they all share this row's OC settings.

ALGO="${1:-}"
if [[ -z "$ALGO" ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <algo_name>"
    exit 1
fi

ALGO_LOWER=$(echo "$ALGO" | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')

case "$ALGO_LOWER" in
overclocking.apply_script_algo_block:
%ALGO%)
        CORE=%Lock Core Clock%
        CORE_OFFSET=%Core Clock Offset%
        MEM=%Lock Memory Clock%
        MEM_OFFSET=%Memory Clock Offset%
        POWER_LIMIT=%Power Limit%
        FAN_MODE="%Fan Mode%"
        FAN_VALUE="%Fan Value%"
        ;;
overclocking.apply_script_footer:
*)
        echo "No OC profile defined for algo '$ALGO' - add a row for it in the dashboard's Overclock module"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

echo "Setting GPU OC for algo '$ALGO': core=$CORE (+$CORE_OFFSET) mem=$MEM (+$MEM_OFFSET) power_limit=$POWER_LIMIT fan=$FAN_MODE:$FAN_VALUE"
CMD=(py-nvtool --setcore "$CORE" --setcoreoffset "$CORE_OFFSET" --setmem "$MEM" --setmemoffset "$MEM_OFFSET")
if [[ -n "$POWER_LIMIT" && "$POWER_LIMIT" != "0" ]]; then
    CMD+=(--setpl "$POWER_LIMIT")
fi
if [[ "$FAN_MODE" == "percent" ]]; then
    CMD+=(--setfan "$FAN_VALUE")
fi
"${CMD[@]}"

if [[ "$FAN_MODE" == "curve" ]]; then
    :
%FAN_CURVE_BLOCK%fi
EOF
sudo chmod +x /usr/local/bin/gpu_apply_ocs.sh
overclocking.fan_curve_service_template:
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/fan-curve.service > /dev/null <<FCEOF
[Unit]
Description=NVIDIA Fan Curve Controller (NVML, no Xorg/Coolbits required)
After=multi-user.target nvidia-persistenced.service
Wants=nvidia-persistenced.service
StartLimitIntervalSec=0
[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
User=root
Environment=PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
TimeoutStartSec=30
WatchdogSec=15
WatchdogSignal=SIGTERM
ExecStartPre=/bin/bash -c 'sleep 3'
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /usr/local/bin/fan_curve.py \
    --interval 2 --hysteresis 2 \
    --cooldown-delta 10 --cooldown-seconds 15 \
    --curve "$FAN_VALUE"
Restart=always
RestartSec=5
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
FCEOF
    sudo systemctl daemon-reload
    sudo systemctl restart fan-curve.service
